Verses.VerseAr: وَالذّٰرِيٰتِ ذَرۡوًاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: By the winds that blow and scatter,

Verses.VerseAr: فَالۡحٰمِلٰتِ وِقۡرًاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And by the clouds that carry a heavy load (of water),

Verses.VerseAr: فَالۡجٰرِيٰتِ يُسۡرًاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And by the vessels that float with elegance,

Verses.VerseAr: فَالۡمُقَسِّمٰتِ اَمۡرًاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And by the angels that distribute work,

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّمَا تُوۡعَدُوۡنَ لَصَادِقٌۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely the promise (of the Hereafter) being made to you is absolutely true.

Verses.VerseAr: وَّاِنَّ الدِّيۡنَ لوَاقِعٌؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And surely the reward and the punishment (of actions) are bound to take place.

Verses.VerseAr: وَالسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ الۡحُـبُكِۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And by the heaven with its galaxies and orbits (of stars and planets),

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّكُمۡ لَفِىۡ قَوۡلٍ مُّخۡتَلِفٍۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Certainly you are (caught) in inconsistent statements.

Verses.VerseAr: يُؤۡفَكُ عَنۡهُ مَنۡ اُفِكَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: He alone turns away (from the Holy Messenger and the Qur’an) who is turned away (from the knowledge of pre-eternity).

Verses.VerseAr: قُتِلَ الۡخَـرّٰصُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Ruined are those who tell lies out of assumption and conjecture,

Verses.VerseAr: الَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ فِىۡ غَمۡرَةٍ سَاهُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Those who are oblivious (of the Hereafter) due to negligence and ignorance.

Verses.VerseAr: يَسۡـَٔــلُوۡنَ اَيَّانَ يَوۡمُ الدِّيۡنِؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: They ask: ‘When is the Day of Requital?’

Verses.VerseAr: يَوۡمَ هُمۡ عَلَى النَّارِ يُفۡتَنُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Say:) ‘The Day (when) they will be roasted in the Fire of Hell.’

Verses.VerseAr: ذُوۡقُوۡا فِتۡنَتَكُمۡؕ هٰذَا الَّذِىۡ كُنۡتُمۡ بِهٖ تَسۡتَعۡجِلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (It will be said to them:) ‘Relish your punishment. It is this punishment which you seek to hasten.’

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ الۡمُتَّقِيۡنَ فِىۡ جَنّٰتٍ وَّعُيُوۡنٍۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely the pious will be (rejoicing) in gardens and springs,

Verses.VerseAr: اٰخِذِيۡنَ مَاۤ اٰتٰٮهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ‌ؕ اِنَّهُمۡ كَانُوۡا قَبۡلَ ذٰلِكَ مُحۡسِنِيۡنَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Receiving those blessings (in ecstatic delight) which their Lord will be giving them (with munificence and benevolence). Surely it is they who were people of spiritual excellence (in their life) before this.

Verses.VerseAr: كَانُوۡا قَلِيۡلاً مِّنَ الَّيۡلِ مَا يَهۡجَعُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: They used to sleep at night only for a short while,

Verses.VerseAr: وَبِالۡاَسۡحَارِ هُمۡ يَسۡتَغۡفِرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And used to (get up and) seek forgiveness in the later part of the night.

Words.MeaningEn: And in the hours before dawn

Verses.VerseAr: وَفِىۡۤ اَمۡوَالِهِمۡ حَقٌّ لِّلسَّآٮِٕلِ وَالۡمَحۡرُوۡمِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And in their wealth was appointed a due share for the beggars and the destitute (i.e. all the needy).

Verses.VerseAr: وَفِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِ اٰيٰتٌ لِّلۡمُوۡقِنِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And there are many Signs in the earth for the people with the truth of certitude (i.e. people of perfect certitude),

Verses.VerseAr: وَفِىۡۤ اَنۡفُسِكُمۡ‌ؕ اَفَلَا تُبۡصِرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And in your selves (as well). So do you not notice?

Verses.VerseAr: وَفِىۡ السَّمَآءِ رِزۡقُكُمۡ وَمَا تُوۡعَدُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (also) there is sustenance for you in the heaven and (all that too) which you are promised.

Verses.VerseAr: فَوَرَبِّ السَّمَآءِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ اِنَّهٗ لَحَـقٌّ مِّثۡلَ مَاۤ اَنَّكُمۡ تَنۡطِقُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So, by the King of heavens and the earth, this (promise of Ours) is true just as is your speech. (You firmly believe in what you utter.)

Verses.VerseAr: هَلۡ اَتٰٮكَ حَدِيۡثُ ضَيۡفِ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمَ الۡمُكۡرَمِيۡنَ‌ۘ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Has the news come to you of the venerable guests of Ibrahim (Abraham)?

Verses.VerseAr: اِذۡ دَخَلُوۡا عَلَيۡهِ فَقَالُوۡا سَلٰمًا‌ؕ قَالَ سَلٰمٌ ۚ قَوۡمٌ مُّنۡكَرُوۡنَ‌‏
Verses.VerseEn: When those (angels) came to him they wished him peace; Ibrahim (Abraham) also said (in reply): ‘Peace (be upon you)!’ (and thought in his mind that) they were strangers.

Verses.VerseAr: فَرَاغَ اِلٰٓى اَهۡلِهٖ فَجَآءَ بِعِجۡلٍ سَمِيۡنٍۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then he went to his home in haste and brought a healthy roasted calf.

Verses.VerseAr: فَقَرَّبَهٗۤ اِلَيۡهِمۡ قَالَ اَلَا تَاۡكُلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then he presented it to them and said: ‘Will you not eat?’

Verses.VerseAr: فَاَوۡجَسَ مِنۡهُمۡ خِيۡفَةً  ‌ؕ قَالُوۡا لَا تَخَفۡ‌ ؕ وَبَشَّرُوۡهُ بِغُلٰمٍ عَلِيۡمٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then he felt somewhat concerned about them (when they did not eat). They (angels) said: ‘Do not worry,’ then they gave him the news about a son possessing knowledge and wisdom (Ishaq [Isaac]).

Words.MeaningEn: and they gave him glad tidings

Verses.VerseAr: فَاَقۡبَلَتِ امۡرَاَتُهٗ فِىۡ صَرَّةٍ فَصَكَّتۡ وَجۡهَهَا وَقَالَتۡ عَجُوۡزٌ عَقِيۡمٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then his wife (Sara) came with a voice laden with wonder and frustration, patted her forehead in astonishment and said: ‘(Will) an old and barren woman (give birth to a child)?’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالُوۡا كَذٰلِكِ ۙ قَالَ رَبُّكِ‌ؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ الۡحَكِيۡمُ الۡعَلِيۡمُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The (angels) said: ‘It will happen exactly as your Lord has said; surely He is Most Wise, All-Knowing.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ فَمَا خَطۡبُكُمۡ اَيُّهَا الۡمُرۡسَلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Ibrahim (Abraham) said: ‘O deputed angels, what is your basic intent (of coming, apart from this good news)?’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالُـوۡۤا اِنَّاۤ اُرۡسِلۡنَاۤ اِلٰى قَوۡمٍ مُّجۡرِمِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: They said: ‘We have been sent to the evildoing people (the people of Lut [Lot]),

Verses.VerseAr: لِنُرۡسِلَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ حِجَارَةً مِّنۡ طِيۡنٍۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So that we may rain on them stones of baked clay,

Verses.VerseAr: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِنۡدَ رَبِّكَ لِلۡمُسۡرِفِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (The stones) that have been marked from your Lord for those who transgress.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَاَخۡرَجۡنَا مَنۡ كَانَ فِيۡهَا مِنَ الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then We moved everyone who was of the believers in it out (from the town of the People of Lut [Lot]).

Verses.VerseAr: فَمَا وَجَدۡنَا فِيۡهَا غَيۡرَ بَيۡتٍ مِّنَ الۡمُسۡلِمِيۡنَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So We did not find in that town (any house) of the Muslims except one (in which were the Prophet Lut [Lot] and his two daughters).

Verses.VerseAr: وَتَرَكۡنَا فِيۡهَاۤ اٰيَةً لِّـلَّذِيۡنَ يَخَافُوۡنَ الۡعَذَابَ الۡاَلِيۡمَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We made in that (town) a Sign to subsist (as a lesson of warning) for those who fear the grievous torment.

Verses.VerseAr: وَفِىۡ مُوۡسَىٰۤ اِذۡ اَرۡسَلۡنٰهُ اِلٰى فِرۡعَوۡنَ بِسُلۡطٰنٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (there are Signs) in (the incident of) Musa (Moses) as well when We sent him to Pharaoh with clear proof.

Verses.VerseAr: فَتَوَلّٰى بِرُكۡنِهٖ وَقَالَ سٰحِرٌ اَوۡ مَجۡنُوۡنٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: He turned away along with his cabinet members and said: ‘(Here is) a magician or a madman.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَاَخَذۡنٰهُ وَجُنُوۡدَهٗ فَنَبَذۡنٰهُمۡ فِىۡ الۡيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيۡمٌؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then We seized him and his army (with torment), and drowned them (all) in the river. And he was but the perpetrator of condemnable works.

Verses.VerseAr: وَفِىۡ عَادٍ اِذۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمُ الرِّيۡحَ الۡعَقِيۡمَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And there is (a Sign) in (the destruction of) the people of ‘Ad too, when We sent upon them a wind devoid of any good and blessing.

Verses.VerseAr: مَا تَذَرُ مِنۡ شَىۡءٍ اَتَتۡ عَلَيۡهِ اِلَّا جَعَلَتۡهُ كَالرَّمِيۡمِؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Whatever it passed over, it did not leave without turning it to dust.

Verses.VerseAr: وَفِىۡ ثَمُوۡدَ اِذۡ قِيۡلَ لَهُمۡ تَمَتَّعُوۡا حَتّٰى حِيۡنٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And also there is (a Sign of warning) in the (destruction of) the people of Thamud when they were told: ‘Take benefit for an appointed term.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَعَتَوۡا عَنۡ اَمۡرِ رَبِّهِمۡ فَاَخَذَتۡهُمُ الصّٰعِقَةُ وَهُمۡ يَنۡظُرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: But they disobeyed the Command of their Lord. So a horrifying thunder seized them, and they could only stare it stunned.

Verses.VerseAr: فَمَا اسۡتَطَاعُوۡا مِنۡ قِيَامٍ وَّمَا كَانُوۡا مُنۡتَصِرِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then they could neither gather strength to stand, nor could they take revenge (on Us).

Verses.VerseAr: وَقَوۡمَ نُوۡحٍ مِّنۡ قَبۡلُ‌ؕ اِنَّهُمۡ كَانُوۡا قَوۡمًا فٰسِقِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (We also destroyed) the People of Nuh (Noah) before this. Surely they were a people extremely disobedient.

Verses.VerseAr: وَالسَّمَآءَ بَنَيۡنٰهَا بِاَيۡٮدٍ وَّاِنَّا لَمُوۡسِعُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We built the heavenly universe with great might. And surely We are expanding (this universe) more and more.

Verses.VerseAr: وَالۡاَرۡضَ فَرَشۡنٰهَا فَنِعۡمَ الۡمَاهِدُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We alone made (the surface of the) earth a (livable) floor. So how graciously We make up and spread out!

Verses.VerseAr: وَمِنۡ كُلِّ شَىۡءٍ خَلَقۡنَا زَوۡجَيۡنِ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَذَكَّرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And of everything We have created two pairs so that you might concentrate and understand.

Verses.VerseAr: فَفِرُّوۡۤا اِلَى اللّٰهِ‌ؕ اِنِّىۡ لَـكُمۡ مِّنۡهُ نَذِيۡرٌ مُّبِيۡنٌ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So run towards Allah. Surely I am a clear Warner to you from Him.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَا تَجۡعَلُوۡا مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰهًا اٰخَرَ‌ؕ اِنِّىۡ لَـكُمۡ مِّنۡهُ نَذِيۡرٌ مُّبِيۡنٌ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And do not set up any god apart from Allah. Surely I am a clear Warner to you from Him.

Verses.VerseAr: كَذٰلِكَ مَاۤ اَتَى الَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِهِمۡ مِّنۡ رَّسُوۡلٍ اِلَّا قَالُوۡا سَاحِرٌ اَوۡ مَجۡنُوۡنٌ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Likewise no Messenger came to those before them but they said the same: ‘(This is) a magician or a madman.’

Verses.VerseAr: اَتَوَاصَوۡا بِهٖ‌ۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمٌ طَاغُوۡنَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Were they transmitting this advice to one another? In truth they were (all) a disobedient and rebellious people.

Words.MeaningEn: Have they transmitted it to them

Verses.VerseAr: فَتَوَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡ فَمَاۤ اَنۡتَ بِمَلُوۡمٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So turn away your kind and caring looks from them. There is no blame on you (for their disbelief).

Verses.VerseAr: وَّذَكِّرۡ فَاِنَّ الذِّكۡرٰى تَنۡفَعُ الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And keep giving direction and guidance, for direction and guidance surely benefits the believers.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَا خَلَقۡتُ الۡجِنَّ وَالۡاِنۡسَ اِلَّا لِيَعۡبُدُوۡنِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And I created the jinn and human beings solely to adopt My servitude.

Verses.VerseAr: مَاۤ اُرِيۡدُ مِنۡهُمۡ مِّنۡ رِّزۡقٍ وَّمَاۤ اُرِيۡدُ اَنۡ يُّطۡعِمُوۡنِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: I do not ask for any sustenance (i.e. earning) from them, nor do I require that they should feed Me.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ هُوَ الرَّزَّاقُ ذُوۡ الۡقُوَّةِ الۡمَتِيۡنُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Truly Allah alone is the Sustainer of everyone, the Lord of Great Might, the Most Strong. (He does not need anyone’s help and assistance.)

Verses.VerseAr: فَاِنَّ لِلَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡا ذَنُوۡبًا مِّثۡلَ ذَنُوۡبِ اَصۡحٰبِهِمۡ فَلَا يَسۡتَعۡجِلُوۡنِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So there is a fixed share of the torment for these wrongdoers (too) like the share of the torment of their companions (who have passed before). So let them not ask Me to hasten (it).

Words.MeaningEn: **so let them not ask Me to hasten.
so let them not ask Me to hasten

Verses.VerseAr: فَوَيۡلٌ لِّـلَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا مِنۡ يَّوۡمِهِمُ الَّذِىۡ يُوۡعَدُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So a terrible destruction awaits the disbelievers on that Day of theirs which they have been promised.
